title: AccountStateChanged
description: The account service publishes one AccountStateChanged event whenever account state changes, and publishes nothing on a read. Nine payload fields carry the account after the change, with widths from the 300-byte account record at app/cpy/CVACT01Y.cpy. Five envelope fields precede them, and the envelope is additive in full: no source record carries one. The authorization service keeps its account_credit_snapshot projection current from the credit limit, the two cycle accumulators and the expiry date this event carries. Evolution is additive only: additionalProperties stays true, so a consumer validating against this version accepts an event that carries a field added by a later version. Inside one version no field is removed, renamed, retyped or narrowed; a change of that kind takes a new schemaVersion and a new -v<n> document beside this one.
$comment: The 178-byte trailing FILLER at app/cpy/CVACT01Y.cpy:L17 carries no data and no field here maps to it. The source spells two fields ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE at app/cpy/CVACT01Y.cpy:L11 and CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE at app/cpy/CVACT02Y.cpy:L9; the target corrects the spelling.

eventId.description: The idempotency key. Each consumer records this identifier before it applies side effects. Additive. No source field exists.

eventType.description: The routing discriminator. A consumer reads this field to learn which payload arrived. Additive. No source field exists.

schemaVersion.description: The contract version. The number matches the -v1 suffix in this file name, and a later version only adds fields. Additive. No source field exists.

occurredAt.description: The publish timestamp, in Coordinated Universal Time. The account service stamps it when it writes the event to its outbox. Additive. No source field exists.

aggregateId.description: The account identifier, and always the Kafka message key. Width from ACCT-ID PIC 9(11) at app/cpy/CVACT01Y.cpy:L5. The Kafka message key, this field and the payload field accountId all carry one value, so account identity has a single source. A publisher compares the key against this field and against accountId, and rejects the message on any difference.

accountId.description: The account identifier, eleven digits. From ACCT-ID PIC 9(11) at app/cpy/CVACT01Y.cpy:L5, the key the account dataset is defined on at app/jcl/ACCTFILE.jcl. A text field keeps a leading zero.

changeType.description: What changed. ACCOUNT_UPDATED covers the field update the online path performs at app/cbl/COACTUPC.cbl:L4066. BILLING_CYCLE_CLOSED covers the cycle close that zeroes both accumulators, which the interest program does at app/cbl/CBACT04C.cbl:L353-L354. Additive: the source publishes nothing and records no change type.

activeStatus.description: The one-character active status, carried through with no interpretation. From ACCT-ACTIVE-STATUS PIC X(01) at app/cpy/CVACT01Y.cpy:L6. No program in app/cbl/ tests this field before posting a transaction, so no consumer may decline on it.

currentBalance.description: The account balance, as a decimal string with two fractional digits. From ACCT-CURR-BAL PIC S9(10)V99 at app/cpy/CVACT01Y.cpy:L7, so ten digits sit before the point. A leading minus is valid. A decimal string keeps a parser from reading the value as a binary floating-point number.

creditLimit.description: The credit limit, as a decimal string with two fractional digits. From ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT PIC S9(10)V99 at app/cpy/CVACT01Y.cpy:L8. The authorization credit-limit rule compares this value against the cycle balance at app/cbl/CBTRN02C.cbl:L403-L413.

cashCreditLimit.description: The cash credit limit, as a decimal string with two fractional digits. From ACCT-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT PIC S9(10)V99 at app/cpy/CVACT01Y.cpy:L9.

currentCycleCredit.description: The cycle credit accumulator, as a decimal string with two fractional digits. From ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT PIC S9(10)V99 at app/cpy/CVACT01Y.cpy:L12. app/cbl/CBTRN02C.cbl:L548-L549 adds a non-negative transaction amount here, and app/cbl/CBACT04C.cbl:L353 zeroes it at cycle close.

currentCycleDebit.description: The cycle debit accumulator, as a decimal string with two fractional digits. From ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT PIC S9(10)V99 at app/cpy/CVACT01Y.cpy:L13. app/cbl/CBTRN02C.cbl:L550-L551 adds a negative transaction amount here, and app/cbl/CBACT04C.cbl:L354 zeroes it at cycle close.

expirationDate.description: The account expiry date, ten characters. From ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE PIC X(10) at app/cpy/CVACT01Y.cpy:L11, which the source spells with the transposed word. The value travels as text and not as a date: app/cbl/CBTRN02C.cbl:L414-L420 compares it character by character against the first ten characters of the transaction origin timestamp to set decline reason 103.
